newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fiat Brazil unit to sell Palio wagons.
newsitem.headline: Fiat Brazil unit to sell Palio wagons.

text.p: Fiat SpA's Brazilian unit will begin selling Palio station-wagons on March 1, a company official said.

The Palio station-wagon model, which had its world launch last week, will be manufactured initially only in Minas Gerais state, said Giovanni Razelli, president of Fiat Auto's Brazilian subsidiary, a unit of Fiat SpA.
With the new car, Fiat hopes to increase its sales of medium-sized cars in Brazil. In 1996, medium-sized cars accounted for 20 percent of total vehicle sales of 1.6 million in Brazil, Razelli said.
Fiat would produce 60,000 Palio station-wagons in Brazil per year, of which 40 percent would be exported to Europe and Asia, he added.
Fiat also plans to produce Palio station-wagons later this year in its plant in Poland to supply Eastern European countries, a company spokesman said.
